title: New License Request: VGT-OL-1.0 (VGT Open License V1)
body:
### 1. License Name
VGT Open License V1

### 2. Short Identifier
VGT-OL-1.0

### 3. License Author / Steward
VisionGaiaTechnology (VGT)
Website: https://visiongaiatechnology.de
Contact: security@visiongaia.de

### 4. Canonical URL / Source of Text
- Official HTML Specification: https://visiongaiatechnology.de/licenses/VGT-Open-License.html
- Official PDF Publication: https://visiongaiatechnology.de/licenses/VGT-Open-License.pdf
- Upstream Project Usage: https://github.com/visiongaiatechnology/AstraeaOS  (Open to the public starting in October)

### 5. Rationale & Use Case
The VGT Open License V1 (VGT-OL-1.0) is a European Strong-Copyleft and Network-Copyleft license designed for sovereign, privacy-preserving desktop and cloud software (specifically the AstraeaOS ecosystem and Astraea Workspace suite).

It combines:
- Strong copyleft for distributed binaries and user products (anti-tivoization).
- Network copyleft for software operated over networks as a service (SaaS/API).
- An explicit ethical field-of-use restriction under Section 13 prohibiting military, intelligence, and weapons-related use without prior written VGT Special Authorization.

Pursuant to Section 18, the German version is the legally controlling version, accompanied by an authorized complete English translation.

### 6. SPDX Inclusion Criteria Confirmation
- [x] The license is not already on the SPDX License List.
- [x] The license text is definitive and stable (Version 1.0, dated 7 September 2026).
- [x] The steward is committed to not changing this version and using semantic versioning for any future revisions.
- [x] The license applies to source code and provides complete access to Corresponding Source.
- [x] The license is actively used in public projects (AstraeaOS, Astraea Workspace, GaiaCom, VGT Infinity).
